rates.heading: Rates
rates.description: Every rate on one scale, so the highest is the one to look at first.
rates.ariaLabel: Rates ranked from highest to lowest

counts.heading: Counts
counts.description: How many different records fall inside the chosen period and area.

breakdown.heading: Breakdowns
breakdown.description: Each total split by its official categories.

unavailable.heading: Not available in this period
unavailable.summaryOne: One metric has no official source
unavailable.body: Nothing is inferred for these. Each carries the reason its source reported.

empty.title: No totals for this period
empty.body: Widen the date range or clear the filters to see results in your area.

error.title: Analytics could not be loaded
error.body: No failed source was represented as zero. Nothing was changed.
error.invalidQuery: That analytics query is not valid

denied.title: You do not have access to analytics
denied.body: Analytics is limited to planning, supervisory and administrative roles.

compare.notice: Comparison period {from} to {to}. Number comparison is off until someone decides.

bottlenecks.heading: Waiting for a setting
bottlenecks.body: Each one is waiting for a setting we cannot guess. Who to count. Over what period. What to compare against.
bottlenecks.strategicBriefNote: It cannot approve, publish, assign, penalise or enforce.
bottlenecks.attentionQueueNote: No live AI request is made.
bottlenecks.exportNote: Pending a canonical audit and correlation contract.

approved_inspection_compliance.title: Approved-inspection compliance
approved_inspection_compliance.definition: Compliant eligible answers ÷ compliant plus non-compliant; zero denominator is N/A.

cancellation_rate.title: Cancellation rate
cancellation_rate.definition: Cancelled visits ÷ visits in the selected planning period.

active_executions.title: Active executions
active_executions.definition: On the way, arrived, or executing.

scheduled_load_count.title: Scheduled load count
scheduled_load_count.definition: Visits you can see. Not a measure of how busy someone is.

factory_approved_outcome_recency.title: Factory approved-outcome recency
factory_approved_outcome_recency.definition: Factory count plus exact latest approved timestamp; no overdue band.

visit_volume.title: Visit volume
visit_volume.definition: Visits whose planning window opens inside the chosen period and area.

published_visit_count.title: Published visits
published_visit_count.definition: Visits at planning status published, against all visits in the period.

draft_backlog_count.title: Draft backlog
draft_backlog_count.definition: Visits still at planning status draft, against all visits in the period.

expired_visit_rate.title: Expired-visit rate
expired_visit_rate.definition: Visits at planning status expired ÷ visits in the period; zero denominator is N/A.

immediate_visit_share.title: Immediate-visit share
immediate_visit_share.definition: Visits planned by the immediate method, or with no plan, ÷ visits in the period.

factory_coverage.title: Factory coverage
factory_coverage.definition: How many different factories have at least one visit in the period and area.

inspector_coverage.title: Inspector coverage
inspector_coverage.definition: How many different inspectors hold a visit you can see. Not a measure of how busy they are.

high_risk_factory_share.title: High-risk factory share
high_risk_factory_share.definition: Visited factories on a high or critical risk band ÷ visited factories carrying any band. Unbanded factories are excluded, never assumed low.

submission_throughput.title: Submission throughput
submission_throughput.definition: Submission versions recorded against inspections of visits in the period.

violation_issue_count.title: Violations issued
violation_issue_count.definition: Violations still in force; invalidated ones are shown separately, never netted off.

penalty_issue_count.title: Penalties issued
penalty_issue_count.definition: Inspection penalties at status issued. No amount is inferred.

evidence_capture_count.title: Evidence captured
evidence_capture_count.definition: Undeleted evidence items linked to a visit or its inspection.

geofence_arrival_compliance.title: Geofence arrival compliance
geofence_arrival_compliance.definition: Arrival and check-in events resolved inside ÷ inside plus outside. Uncertain results are excluded from both sides.

review_return_rate.title: Review return rate
review_return_rate.definition: Latest decisions that returned ÷ all latest decided reviews.

review_rejection_rate.title: Review rejection rate
review_rejection_rate.definition: Latest decisions that rejected ÷ all latest decided reviews.

review_turnaround_hours.title: Review turnaround
review_turnaround_hours.definition: Mean hours from inspection submission to the latest review decision. Reviews missing either timestamp are excluded.

notification_delivery_rate.title: Notification delivery rate
notification_delivery_rate.definition: Delivered or read ÷ attempted notifications in the period. Notifications with no configured channel are excluded from both sides.

ai_suggestion_adoption_rate.title: AI suggestion adoption
ai_suggestion_adoption_rate.definition: Suggestions used ÷ suggestions that were decided. Suggestions still waiting for a decision are left out.
